MPESB MP Police SI, Subedar Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has released the notification for the post of Sub Inspector SI & Subedar. This recruitment has been issued for 507 posts. The online application process for MPESB MP Police SI, Subedar Recruitment 2026 has started from 09 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 23 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB MP Police SI, Subedar Recruitment 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 September 2026
  • Last Date : 23 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 23 September 2026
  • Last Date Correction : 28 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 560/-
  • EWS, OBC, SC, ST, PwD : Rs. 310/-
  • Portal Charges Extra Include
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
